verdict.rationale: Godot ships multiple official, well-documented SDKs/APIs for building against the engine — GDScript, C# (.NET), GDExtension/C++ bindings, a full command-line interface, and editor scripting APIs (EditorScript, EditorInterface, plugin system) — all usable for programmatic/automated workflows an AI-native user could drive. Community evidence confirms C# and CLI usage work in practice, though C# is noted as a 'second class citizen' relative to GDScript. Missing for 10: AI-agent-specific SDK examples or guidance, independent corroboration of automation/agentic use beyond basic scripting, and any officially documented agent/automation-oriented API layer.
